summary: Wire the automation MCP operations into the application: pkg/mcp/mcpwiring is the MCP composition (on when the application passes its mcp.Registry with an Authorizer, a ConfirmingAuditor and ApprovalURL; no *_ENABLED flag) that registers the tools modules contribute (ContributeTools) and the guarded-changes service over the contributed kinds (ContributeKinds) with changes.Config.Auditor, and calls DispatchEffects periodically in API/worker processes. The automations module contributes mcpops.Tools and mcpops.Kinds with its pages under http.origin and sets engine.Config.Links to the editor's run pages by default. Adds a READ COMMITTED regression test for engine ListVersions.
